dish.title: Georgian Chkmeruli: Crisp Chicken Thighs in Garlic Cream Sauce
dish.description: Bone-in chicken thighs seared skin-side down until crackling, roasted in the same cast-iron skillet, then bathed in a sauce of garlic, butter, whole milk, and cream with ground coriander, scattered with cilantro, and served with crusty bread for the sauce.

recipe_version.title: Georgian Chkmeruli: Crisp Chicken Thighs in Garlic Cream Sauce
recipe_version.description: Bone-in chicken thighs seared skin-side down until crackling, roasted in the same cast-iron skillet, then bathed in a sauce of garlic, butter, whole milk, and cream with ground coriander, scattered with cilantro, and served with crusty bread for the sauce.

ingredients.name: bone-in skin-on chicken thighs
ingredients.display_name: bone-in skin-on chicken thighs (6, about 6 oz each)

ingredients.name: crusty bread
ingredients.display_name: crusty loaf whose label lists wheat flour, water, yeast, and salt

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 425 F. Pat the thighs very dry and season all over with the salt, pepper, and coriander. Mince the garlic and chop the cilantro.

steps.title: Sear skin-side down
steps.body: Lay the thighs skin-side down in the cold 12-inch cast-iron skillet (6 fit in one layer). Set over medium and cook without moving until the skin is deep golden and crisp, about 12 minutes.

steps.title: Roast
steps.body: Turn the thighs skin-side up and roast in the oven until 175 F at the bone, about 20 minutes. With oven mitts, move the chicken to the large plate and pour off all but 1 tbsp fat.

steps.title: Garlic cream sauce
steps.body: Set the skillet over medium (handle hot). Melt the butter, add the garlic, and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Pour in the milk and cream, scrape up the browned bits, and simmer until slightly thickened, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Return and serve
steps.body: Return the thighs skin-side up into the sauce, spoon sauce around (not over) the skin, scatter cilantro, and serve from the skillet with sliced bread.
